method: Original Character10 vtable slot05 at 0x00788284 directly selects 0x004654A0. Canonical complete code owner [0x004654A0,0x0046886B) contains 13259 original code bytes / 3391 i386 instructions and is followed by five CC alignment bytes. Pinned native VC7.1 /Od /G6 /MT /Gy /W3 produces original full 0xC0 frame, 13259/13259 original bytes and exactly 232/232 original-bound COFF relocations across 39 symbols (RandomRange, CRT fabs, CollisionSide, float references). Complete strict compare and selected unit cold replay return Exact, zero differences, SHA-256 equal. No inline assembler, machine byte masks, hand-shaped padding or all-unit cold replay; whole-game runtime/linkage remains a separate task.
